probes.name: text-set-null
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object,n As Long
On Error GoTo Failed
Set f=Range("K3:K8").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=9,String:="foo",TextOperator:=0)
f.Text=Null
Probe=Inspect(f) & "|bold=" & Prop(f.Font,"Bold") & "|count=" & Cells.FormatConditions.Count
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & "|count=" & Cells.FormatConditions.Count
If Not f Is Nothing Then Probe=Probe & "|" & Inspect(f)
End Function
Function Prop(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
Prop="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
Prop="Empty(0)"
Else
Prop=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
Prop="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Inspect(f As Object) As String
Dim k As Variant
Inspect="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & f.AppliesTo.Address
For Each k In Array("Type","Operator","Formula1","Formula2","Priority","StopIfTrue","TopBottom","Rank","Percent","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator","ScopeType")
Inspect=Inspect & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & Prop(f,CStr(k))
Next
End Function
